text:
Terrible arguments.

and, finally, lying peacefully

in her long bed

printed

in red with fresh flower designs,

my head and belly down

head to the sides

bathed by dull light

while she bathes silently in the

other room,

everything goes beyond me,

like most things,

I hear classical music on the little radio,

she bathes, I hear the sound of water.

translation.title: The Tigress
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the quiet aftermath of argument and the speaker's passive listening from the bed.
